title: Keyturn Trip Booking: A Guest's Own Request to Keep the Vehicle Longer
content:
A guest who wants a Keyturn Trip Booking vehicle for longer is quoted a price for the extra time before the request goes onto the extension request register. A quote for extra time is not fixed before the reservation carries the young-driver surcharge owed on the driver named on it.

Lodging the request puts one entry on the extension request register against that reservation, carrying the new last day wanted, how much longer that is and the price the desk quoted for the extra time, and leaves it standing as submitted and waiting on the host. The reservation itself is untouched: its dates, its allowance and its balance stay as they were, and the guest can see the request and the price they were quoted on it.

Until the surcharge owed on the named driver is carried by the reservation, the quote for the extra time is not yet fixed.

### Making the call

The request is lodged with `submit_extension_request_8f69bfd6`. This is the guest's own tool over the guest's own reservation: the desk unlocks it and hands it over, and it is run by the customer themselves rather than by the agent.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `booking_id` | The reference number of the guest's own trip reservation the request is put against, as the desk read it out from the trip booking lookup. | Id class. |
| `customer_id` | The member reference number of the guest asking, as the desk read it out from the member profile lookup. | Id class. |
| `requested_end_date` | The new last day of the trip being asked for. | Fixed-format class: written as YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar date in the same time zone the trip dates are kept in, never a range and never blank. |
| `additional_hours` | How much longer the vehicle is wanted for, measured from the return currently scheduled. | Fixed-format class: hours, 1 decimal place, positive. |
| `quoted_amount` | The price the desk quoted for that extra time. | Fixed-format class: USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent, positive. |

`booking_id` and `customer_id` are identifiers of the Id class; `requested_end_date`, `additional_hours` and `quoted_amount` are each of the Fixed-format class.

### Return

The call returns an acknowledgement sentence naming the reference number of the new request, the reservation it stands against, the new last day asked for and the amount quoted in USD to two decimal places. Receiving that sentence means the request is on the register and waiting on the host; anything else means nothing was lodged.
